statement: Squire is the best character for mining.
Barbarian could mine but is better prioritized for fishing first.
Level Fists of Rage (flat strength), Brute Efficiency (mining % boost) and Idle Skilling (AFK gains) on the first tab.
Copper Collector is the first priority on the second tab; it boosts mining efficiency by a percent per power of 10 of copper in chest.
Tool Proficiency gives mining power percent for every ten Squire levels.
Big Pick and Mother Lode are more for active farming so level them as second priority.
Minor talent is good for multi-ore chance but does not increase efficiency.
Firmly Grasp and Absolute Unit give extra strength which helps efficiency in the long run.
Third tab: take Back to Basics for a little extra talent points.
More strength raises the max level of first-tab talents which adds efficiency.
Getting talent books from the library gives extra talent levels to further increase efficiency.
Level up your pickaxe; gold is worse than plat and plat is worse than dementia.
Prioritize party dungeon star talents Super Source (base efficiency) and Action Frenzy (speed of all skills).
Prioritize orange bubbles in alchemy: three small bubbles and one big bubble.
Hearty Diggy is the first priority; gives efficiency per power of 10 of max HP.
Upgrade Health Overdrive on talent second tab to reach 1k max health for Hearty Diggy.
You will only get over a thousand max HP until super late game.
Strong Tools (sixth bubble) gives 2 percent more power; icing on the cake especially with a void pick.
Wyoming Blood raises multi-ore chance cap to 300 percent instead of 100 percent but is not efficiency.
Take Warriors Rule once other small orange bubbles are about 30 to 50; it multiplies orange passive bubbles and doubles bonus at level 50.
Two Rex Rings give 5 percent skill efficiency each and are bought at the party dungeon Flurbo shop.
Craft Viking Cap (+10 percent) and Caravan Trekkers boots (+20 percent) from unlocks tab.
Craft Coal Miner pants for extra +5 efficiency.
Upgrade Dwarven Supply Box to 400 for extra 33 percent mining efficiency plus a prowess effect.
Prowess lowers the efficiency required to mine that ore type and gives up to 9.47 AFK gains.
Key cards: Amarok (AFK gains), 3-star Iron Ore 20% efficiency, Plator 8% AFK, Dementia Ore 16 mining speed, Frost Flakes 28 base strength, Bunny 4% AFK, Tyson 20 strength.
Getting all easy resource cards to 3 star gives 32 skill efficiency.
Mining power ovals come from the gem shop or from liquid shop grand/decent/mediocre ovals; gem shop not recommended.
Only upgrade ovals to silver; gold rarity turns them into square ovals.
Unlock Hydron constellation to equip three constellations; otherwise Cronus Cosmos allows only two.
Dwarfo Beardus is the first major constellation: +5 percent mining efficiency and +20 percent multi-ore chance.
OG Skiller gives +5 percent carry cap +1 percent skill AFK gain and +2 percent all-skill prowess.
With Hydron take Big Comatose as the third constellation for skill AFK gain.
Get Pickaxe stamp and Cool Diggy Tool stamp which increase base mining efficiency.
Base mining efficiency scales with percent efficiency so more base benefits you more later.
Mining statue gives mining power like weapon power which increases based mining efficiency.
Use Skilled Dimwit prayer: less XP gain but extra 63 skill efficiency (base about 50); unlocked via tower defense.
Use Gifty Bread Man and Icing Iron Bite for mining speed to get a big 3D print.
Pearls can also be used for extra AFK gains for the 3D printer though he lacks them.
He has 90 percent AFK gain rate and 35 percent chance with 993k efficiency; enough for a good 3D print.
With this setup he gets 1576 void ore per hour.
Keep upgrading health and the three alchemy bubbles to mine void ore and eventually luster ore.
Luster ore comes with World 4 which is coming soon.
